newsitem.title: USA: Olympic says Feb 97 JFK air cargo up 17pct.
newsitem.headline: Olympic says Feb 97 JFK air cargo up 17pct.

text.p: Olympic Airways Cargo said it handled 17 percent more commercial freight in February 1997 compared to the same period 1996.

Nick Georgatos, cargo sales manager U.S., based at New York's John F. Kennedy airport, said it carried 187 tonnes of of outward bound commercial freight in February against 161 tonnes in the same 1996 period.
"We can only say it looks like it will be a good year, things are already picking up," Georgatos said.

The carrier has announced an additional 30 Boeing 747-200 flights will operate on the New York to Athens route between June 4 and September 10. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
